judgments.reason: The DOI is the bigP3BCI PhysioNet dataset record. Its authors match, and this Study N is a subset of that collection, so it is the same deposit the dataset is derived from.
judgments.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS; it is not a paper describing this BigP3BCI dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data organization, a standard used by this dataset's format, not a paper describing the BigP3BCI Study N data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
